details.open_source_desc: This project is open-sourced on GitHub
details.background_desc: The purpose of this blog is to record daily learning, technical sharing and project experience. I hope to practice the technologies involved in full-stack development, system design and DevOps deployment through this project. In the old version of the blog, some functional designs were relatively simplistic. Therefore, the brand-new NoteForest X version fixes the bugs existing in the old version and expands some new features.
details.frontend_list_1: Nuxt4 —— Used to provide SSR/SSG capabilities
details.frontend_list_2: Vue3 + TypeScript —— Core development framework and programming language
details.frontend_list_3: Vite —— Serves as a high-performance build tool
details.frontend_list_5: md-editor-v3 —— Used for Markdown text editing and rendering
details.frontend_list_6: GSAP, Pinia, Tailwind CSS, Flag Icons —— Animation, state management, styling and icon libraries
details.frontend_desc: The reason for choosing Vue is its lightweight architecture, high efficiency and comprehensive ecosystem. Meanwhile, I have been using Vue for a long time and am very familiar with its development paradigm.
details.backend_list_1: Golang —— High-performance, concise core backend programming language
details.backend_list_2: Custom REST API based on GIN —— Provides data interfaces for articles, illustration collections and user systems
details.backend_list_3: Redis —— Used for caching, session storage and query acceleration
details.backend_list_4: MySQL/MariaDB —— Persistent storage for the corresponding paths of articles and illustrations
details.backend_list_5: Anubis —— Lightweight web AI firewall utility
details.backend_list_6: Docker + Nginx + pm2 —— Underlying tools for deployment and runtime
details.backend_desc: The core design philosophy of the backend is to maintain simplicity and high efficiency, and separate business logic from data processing into different layers as much as possible to improve maintainability.

my_design.section1_desc: Keep the user interface concise and modern without compromising the user experience.
my_design.step0_content: Select font types, font sizes and font weights.
my_design.step1_content: Adjust element positions and set appropriate spacing between elements.
my_design.step2_content: Choose a color palette with sufficient contrast ratio.
my_design.step3_content: Add visual effects such as borders, shadows and rounded corners.
my_design.section2_desc: Focus on operational convenience, user interface consistency, and continuously optimize the user experience.
my_design.section3_desc: Writing clean and tidy code is the primary principle, while also taking into account maximum performance optimization.

my_work.main_desc: Browse the programming languages, libraries and tools I have used.
my_work.intro: I have been engaged in web development for about 9 years, having tried various programming languages and technology stacks, covering both backend and frontend development. Although the web development field is extensive, I am particularly interested in and focused on frontend development and UI/UX design.
my_work.app_dev_desc1: I love creating clean, minimalist, aesthetic and valuable works, which are certainly easy to use.
my_work.app_dev_desc2: I especially enjoy building websites with rich UI components, including:
my_work.tool_intro: But I still love creating simple web pages, such as landing pages. What are the tools I am most familiar with using during website production?
my_work.vue_tech_desc1: Single-page websites are my specialty, and Vue.js is like my magic wand. I have been using it for many years and have created more and more beautiful works.
my_work.vue_tech_desc2: First of all, for programming languages, I am used to using TypeScript, although PHP and Python can also be used for web development. TypeScript has been with me for about 7 years.
my_work.backend_tech_desc: I use them to build scalable and high-performance backend services, covering everything from API design to data operations. Initially, I focused on backend development, but later I realized that CLI could not meet all needs, so I started learning GUI development.
my_work.ops_desc: Initially stemming from a strong interest in the IT industry, I came into contact with Linux at an early age. After several years of learning, I have now deployed multiple services using virtualization and Linux, including but not limited to edge computing services, file directory programs, personal blogs, Zabbix monitoring, SoftEtherVPN, etc.
